409.description: The run is not waiting for approval

Band.title: Band
Band.description: A zone's risk band from its landslide and flood indices (``gridline.threats.indices``).

Event.title: Event
Event.description: Any event on the bus or the WebSocket, discriminated by ``event_type``.

IndustrialFire.title: IndustrialFire
IndustrialFire.description: A fire at a site in a zone; who is exposed is computed from the city by the apply handler.

RainfallDriver.title: RainfallDriver
RainfallDriver.description:
Operator rain: ``intensity_mm_h`` over ``zone_ids`` (empty means every zone) for ``duration_h`` hours.

A driver, not a reading: the scenario's rain resumes when it ends and is never lowered by it.

ScenarioTrigger.title: ScenarioTrigger
ScenarioTrigger.description: An operator pressed a DEMO control; its injected events and one simulated hour follow on the bus.

SimSnapshotPayload.title: SimSnapshotPayload
SimSnapshotPayload.description: Typed view of the ``sim.snapshot`` payload (``payloads.SimSnapshot`` keeps world and city as dicts).

SourceStatus.title: SourceStatus
SourceStatus.description: Which data source feeds the bus: DEMO (the Nandipur simulation) or LIVE (real weather, real city).

TriggerInfo.title: TriggerInfo
TriggerInfo.description: A DEMO button as the dashboard lists it (``GET /api/city``).

WeatherObservation.title: WeatherObservation
WeatherObservation.description: A rain gauge reports rainfall, the wind station wind and temperature; unmeasured fields are None.

WorkflowPath.title: WorkflowPath
WorkflowPath.description: ``nodes[i] --relations[i]--> nodes[i+1]``, each hop backed by the KG edge in ``citation_ids[i]``.

WorkflowStep.title: WorkflowStep
WorkflowStep.description: The ``agent.step`` payload: the latest state of one node of one run.

WorldSnapshot.title: WorldSnapshot
WorldSnapshot.description: Frozen, JSON-safe export of the whole world (``sim.snapshot`` and ``GET /api/simulation/snapshot``).

ZoneStatePayload.title: ZoneStatePayload
ZoneStatePayload.description: One zone's risk indices after a tick (``gridline.threats.indices``): a signal, never a decision.
